content: Jesus koorlangweta
Yeyi Djelyib Augustus koordook djinanginy ngalan moorta wininginy baalang boodjeral.
Nidja koriyat bordakiny kolang moortamanang. Nidja edjena nginda Qurinius nyiny birdiyar Syria-ang.
Moortaman koorl baalaparoo karlamaya, maam-inramang karlamaya. Bokadja, baalap boordak baalapang kola mili-milikal.
Joseph wandja Nazareth, Galilee-kang karlamaya, kidji koorl Bethlehem, karlamaya Judea-kal. Djelyib David kwadja-koorlangweta Bethlehem-al. Joseph koorl Bethlehem narla baal djoowak David-ang.
Baal wer baalang koort-maat Mary, koodjal koorl Bethlehem boordakak baalapang kola. Mary-yang ngoongoolonga kwadja-yanga Mary-yany Joseph koorta-barranginy. Mary boodjari.
Koodjal yoowal-koorl Bethlehem, karro dji edjena Mary-yang yidjiny baalang maawit.
Mary yidja baalang koriyat nop, baal wolang baalany bwokal kidji baal ngoming baalany mayakal booliyakang merenyang, narla yoowart ngowort koodjalang ngwoorndak karlamayakal.
Kookendjeriyang-yakina wer djin-djina-kwabba
Alitja boodjeral, kookendjeriyang-yakina kwadja-yaka bandak kadikal, baalapang kookendjerira karrodjininy.
Kenyang Boolanga-Yirang djin-djin-kwabba yoowal-koorl baalapany-ngat, kidji Boolanga-Yirang moorditj-moorditj binari yira-birrikon baalapany. Baalap wayarn-djil.
Yalga djin-djin-kwabba waangki baalapany, “Yoowart wayarn! Ngany yoowal-koorl, kwabba warda noonookak barranginy. Nidja warda boorda barrang djoorab-djoorab-djil moortamanak!
“Yeyi nidja kedela, David-ang karlamayakal, Keny-Barranginy-Ngandabat koorlangweta - Christ Birdiyar!
Kidji noonooka karnarny boorda-djinang: noonooka maawit boorda-djinang, bwokal wolang-yan, kidji mayakal merenyang ngwoorndiny.”
Yilak-yilak, boola-boola djin-djina-kwabba ngarda-koorl Boolanga-Yirakang Boodjer-yen. Baalap yaaka warma djin-djin-kwabba-ngat, warrangkiny kidji Boolanga-Yirany yanganiny.
“Moorditj-moorditj yanganan Boolanga-Yirak,

Nginda djin-djina-kwabba korl-koorl Boolanga-Yirang Boodjer, kookendjeriyang-yakina dandjo-waangki, “Ngala boorda-koorl Bethlehem kidji ngala djinang nidja noolong, naatj Boolanga-Yira waangki boorda-edjena.”
Baalap wort-kakoodjen kidji baalap yoowal-koorl Mary-any wer Joseph. Baalap djinang maawit. Baal mayakal merenyang ngwoorndiny.
Nginda kookendjeriyang-yakina djinang maawit, baalap warranga koodjalany natj djin-djin-kwabba waangki koorlangang.
Koodjal kai-kai nginda koodjal dwangka nidja-nidja noolonga, moodlooka kookendjeriyang-yakina waangki.
Mary barrang-dwangka mandang nidja-nidja noolonga, kidji baal barrang-yalgawa moodlooka baalang koortal.

Kookendjeriyang-yakina korl-koorl, yedi-waangkiny kidji Boolanga-Yirany yanganiny narla moodlookang natj baalap kwadja-dwangka kidji djinang. Moodlooka kwadja-edjena, moodlooka djin-djin-kwabba waangki baalapany.
Baalap kolitj Jesus

Ngolanga maar-koodjal kedelara, kedela yoowal-koorl kardjatak maawit, alimarn Warriny waangki. Koodjal kolitj baalany ‘Jesus’, narla djin-djin-kwabba yanga koodjalany alitja kol koora Mary boodjari-biny.
Mary wer Joseph barrang Jesus Maya-maya-Kooranyikal
Kedela yoowal-koorl nginda Joseph wer Mary-yang boorda-don maawitang Kedela Barnanang alimarn Moses-ang Warriny waangki. Ngarl koodjal barrang maawit Jerusalem-ak, yangak baalany Boolanga-Yirakak,
narla boordakiny Boolanga-Yirang Warrinyal waangki, “Noonooka boorda yanga noonookang koryat nop Boolanga-Yirak.”
Koodjal kardjir djarnyak yanga-narra koodjal djert, alimarn Boolanga-Yirang Warriny waangki, mana-barangka ka nembing.
Alidja-alidja kedalara, Simeon nyiny Jerusalem. Baal kwabba mammarap. Baal ala Boolanga-Yira kidji baal ngayaka kedela nginda Boolanga-Yira boorda barrang-ngandabat Israel.
Kangya-Kooranyi nyiny Simeon-bwora kidji Kangya warranga baalany natj baal yoowart boorda wanni kwadjat baal djinang kedela nginda Keny boorda-yoowal-koorl, Keny Boolanga-Yira Waangki-Koorliny.
Kangya-Kooranyi barrang Simeon Maya-maya-Kooranyi-bwora. Winidjinbar, Jesus-ang maaman wer ngaangk barrang maawit Maya-maya-Kooranyi bwora, doniny natj Boolanga-Yirang Warriny waangki.
Simeon maara-barrang maawit kidji yanganan Boolanga-Yira.

Noonook kwadja-don nidja noolong moortaman booram:

content: Jesus-ang maaman wer ngaangk kai-kai dwangko nidja-nidja noolonga, moodlooka Simeon waangki Jesus-ang.

Simeon yanga-kwabba baalapany kidji baal waangki Mary, Jesus-ang ngaangkany, “Boolanga-Yira waangki-koorl nidja koorlang moortak Israel-ang. Baal boorda djakanak boola moorta kidji baal boorda barrangak-ngandabat boola moorta. Baal Boolanga-Yirang ngambany. Boola moorta boorda wara-waangki baalany.
Moorta kobin baalapang kaaditjiny, yalga moodlooka boorda-djinang-yan. Kidji winyan boorda-kardjat noonang koort djarp djillab-mokiny.”

Anna, baal nyiny karbarli yenang, kidji baal nyiny Warda Marridjiny. Baal Phanuel-ang kowart, ngoongoolong Asher-ang. Baal kwadja-koorta-barrang arda maar-koodjal biroka kidji yeyi baal kadak 84 biroka. Baal yoowart wort-koorl Maya-maya-Kooranyi. Kedela wer kadik, baal yanganan Boolanga-Yirany, yoowart ngarniny, kidji kalyakool Boolanga-Yira waangkiny.
Winidjinbar, baal yoowal-koorl kidji baal yanganan Boolanga-Yira. Baal waangki moortaman, alidja-alidja nganayaka Boolanga-Yira boorda yalkaran Jerusalem. Anna warrang baalap koorlangang.
Baalap korl-koorl Nazareth
Ngolanga Joseph wer Mary nganitj moodlooka, mandang noolonga Boolanga-Yirang Warriny waangki, koodjalil korl-koorl koodjalang karlap, karlamaya Nazareth Galilee-kal.
Koorlang maladja kidji mardayin-biny; baal kwadja moorart-biny karnarnyang wer kaaditjinyang, kidji Boolanga-Yira yanga-kwabba baalany.
Koorlang Jesus Maya-maya-Kooranyikal
Djilba yoowal-koorl, ngarl Jesus-ang maaman wer ngaangk kalyakool koorl Jerusalem Mandjar Djendjeriny-Yirakang.
Nginda Jesus kadak 12 biroka, baalap koorl Mandjarak, alimarn kalyakool.
Ngolanga Mandjar, koodjal malyak korl-koorliny koodjalang karlap, yalga Jesus, koodjalang nop, baal naan-yaaka Jerusalem-al. Baalang maaman wer ngaangk yoowart kaaditj.
Koodjal kaaditj Jesus kwadja-koorl koodjalang ngooloongongal, ngarl koodjal koorl keny kedela kidji karro koodjal malyak koorl-djinanginy Jesus koodjalang babina wer ngoonoolonga kardakor.
Koodjal yoowart djinang Jesus, ngarl koodjal korl-koorl Jerusalem, baalany koorl-djinanginy.
Ngolanga mo kedelara, koodjalil djinang Jesus Maya-maya-Kooranyi-bwora Mammarap Warrinyang-boongal, baalapany dwangkiny kidji baalapany waangki-djinanginy.
Moortaman Jesus-any aliny, baalap kai-kai narla baalang kaaditjinyang wer baalang warrinya.

Jesus-ang maaman wer ngaangk kai-kai nginda koodjal djinang baalany, kidji Jesus-ang ngaangk waangki baalany, “Nop, nadjil noonook don nidja noolong ngalak? Noonang maaman wer ngany kwadja-wayarn kidji ngala koordook djinango noonany.”

Jesus waangki koodjalany, “Nadjil nyoodjoowal djarnyak yoowal-koorl nidjap, nganyany korl-djinanginy? Nyoodjoowal yoowart kaaditj natj ngany djarnyak nyiny nidja, nganyang Maamanang Maya-maya-bwora, wa?”
Yalga koodjal yoowart kaaditj Jesus-ang warrinya.
Ngarl Jesus koorl Nazareth koodjalyel. Bokadja, baal dwangka koodjalany, moodlooka doniny koodjal ngakaka. Jesus-ang ngaank kanya mandang nidja-nidja noolonga baalang koort-bwora.
Jesus maladja mardayinal wer kaadjitinyal, kidji baal kwabba maladja Boolanga-Yirang miyalakal wer moortakang miyalakal.
